verdict.rationale: Navan documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.navan.com/mcp. It gives concrete setup paths for Claude Code (`claude mcp add`), a Cursor plugin and VS Code `mcp.json`, uses SSO/password auth scoped to the user's permissions, and lists capabilities across spend, travel, policy and card data. A probe confirms the MCP docs and llms.txt are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work as documented.
